newsitem.title: USA: New West Eyeworks Sept. sales rise.
newsitem.headline: New West Eyeworks Sept. sales rise.

text.p: New West Eyeworks Inc Monday said sales for the third quarter ended September 28 rose rose 15.7 percent to approximately $11.7 million, versus $10.1 million in the prior-year period.Comparable-store sales increased 14.2 percent during the quarter.

For the nine-month period net sales rose 9.7 percent to approximately $34.0 million, compared with $31.0 million in the corresponding period of the previous year. Same store sales rose 9.2 percent for the first nine months of the 1996 year.

Sales during the third quarter and first nine months of last year included $162,000 and $989,000, respectively, of revenues generated by unprofitable or underperforming "host" stores which were closed during 1995. If prior-year sales from the closed retail outlets are excluded from last year's results, New West's third quarter 1996 net sales would have increased 17.6 percent to 11.7 million versus $9.9 million, while net revenues for the nine-month period would have posted a 13.3 percent gain to $34 million versus $30 million.

"In light of the acceleration in same-store sales growth during our third quarter and the effect of our cost cutting programs, we expect the company to report improved profitability for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 28, 1996, when compared with prior-year results," said Chairman Ronald Weinberg. "For 1997, we have identified new markets which appear attractive for expansion, and the company expects to continue its new store opening program."
